name: Guangdong Anda Automation Solutions Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Anda Automation Solutions Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent manufacturing equipment and system platforms in China and internationally. The company offers dispensing machines, coating machines, AOI inspections, glue filling machines, potting machines, plasma cleaning machines, curing ovens, intelligent assembly equipment, ADA intelligent platforms, five-axis linkage CNC machine tools, ultra-fast laser equipment, warehousing and logistics equipment, and other intelligent manufacturing equipment, as well as dispensing valve bodies, drive controls, motors, and other components.
